item.title: Cameron Hooker Invented A Secret Group To Prevent Escape
item.description: Abducted in California in 1977, Colleen Stan endured seven years of captivity while Cameron Hooker threatened her with a fictitious organization called “The Company.” His wife eventually exposed the lie, helping Stan leave. Hooker was convicted in 1985 and sentenced to 104 years.

item.title: Two Bodies Beneath Estibaliz Carranza’s Ice Cream Shop
item.description: Maintenance workers discovered the remains of Estibaliz Carranza’s ex-husband and boyfriend in concrete beneath her Vienna ice cream shop in 2011. She fled to Italy but was arrested days later. In 2012, she was convicted of both murders and sentenced to life.

item.title: The Feeding Bag Lacey Spears Asked A Friend To Hide
item.description: After five-year-old Garnett Spears died in New York in 2014, investigators found high salt levels in a feeding bag his mother had asked a friend to hide. Lacey Spears was convicted of second-degree murder in 2015 and sentenced to 20 years to life

item.title: Brittany Norwood Used Size-14 Shoes To Stage A Robbery
item.description: Jayna Murray was killed at a Maryland Lululemon store in 2011. Her coworker Brittany Norwood planted footprints with men’s shoes and falsely claimed masked intruders had attacked them. Norwood was convicted of first-degree murder and sentenced to life without parole in 2012.
